response.rationale: RinkService uses two separate repositories: ClubBookingRepository.create and BookingRepository.create, so the two concepts are stored separately. A club booking is created with date, start, end and rink 'halves', which looks like a club reserving part of the rink for a time slot. Booking is reached through session-, membership-, hold-, purchase-, payment-result- and expiry-related methods (listBySession, listByMembership, holdSession, purchase, handlePaymentResult, expireOverdue), which points to an individual's paid booking on a session. They share timing attributes and the word 'booking', but they model different real-world things.
